content:
**Relay Tower HN-B1-12** is a location in The Forest region of Appalachia.

This location is a standard radio relay tower with Machinegun Turrets guarding its entrances, formerly controlled by the U.S. military. Inside is a blue system relay terminal which US Government Supply Requisition holotapes can be loaded into to call for supply drops. There is a bank of lockers along its southwestern wall and a locked Footlocker (Picklock 0) and Ammo Box in the corner of the room. There is also a First Aid next to its southeast entrance.

- Letter to Linda - Note, east of the tower next to Route 91, in a military Off-Road Vehicle crashed against a tree, in the hand of a Skeleton.
- US Government Supply Requisition - Holotape, on the blue console behind a metal shelf with a radio.
- Potential Vault-Tec Bobblehead - Inside the building, on the small mainframe computer bank.
- Potential Magazine - Inside the building, on top of the mainframe computer terminal attached to the central pillar, facing southwest (if looking at the middle pillar).

- Request Government Air Drop: A US Government Supply Requisition holotape can be used in the relay tower terminal.

Relay Tower HN-B1-12 appears in *Fallout 76*.

- Interior
- Vault-Tec Bobblehead location
